title: Rav Huna son of Rav Hoshaya
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Horayot 3b; Hyman suggests that perhaps the reading should be “son of Rav Yehoshua.” In Yalkut, Mishlei, remez 954: “Rav Huna bar Hoshaya said: and it crowns him like the awn on an ear of grain.” But the statement is in Sotah 5a, and there it is Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua.

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Sotah 5a compares a small amount of pride adorning a scholar to the awn adorning an ear of grain: ליה refers to the scholar. It explicitly has Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua; Horayot 3b has Hoshaya. Hyman’s suggested emendation remains tentative.
